<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">

  <!-- Base of the chest -->
  <link name="base">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.36 0.60"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.36 0.60"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.816" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="1.720" iyz="0.0"
               izz="2.104"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Lid of the chest -->
  <link name="lid">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.18 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.02 0.36"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="dark_brown">
        <color rgba="0.36 0.20 0.09 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.18 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.02 0.36"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.18 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.054" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.376" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.430"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinge joint for the lid -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Hinge line is at the back edge of the chest, at the top surface -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.18 0.60" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit effort="10.0" velocity="1.0" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
